ProjectPersonas.label: Model Project
ProjectPersonas.description: Rigorous team; delighted written-medium community; enthusiastic involved pastor. Every lens should score high with strong cross-lens agreement.

ProjectPersonas.label: Strong Team / Unconvinced Community
ProjectPersonas.description: Rigorous team (with one less-rigorous member) but a written-medium community that finds the result hard to follow. Tests whether a Team/Community split shows up as low cross-lens agreement rather than being averaged away.

ProjectPersonas.label: Under-Resourced but Loved
ProjectPersonas.description: Ad-hoc, under-documented team process, but the written-medium community loves the result. The inverse split from strong-team-unconvinced-community.

ProjectPersonas.label: Struggling Project
ProjectPersonas.description: Ad-hoc team, unconvinced community, disengaged pastor — uniformly weak across all three lenses.

RespondentPersonas.label: Rigorous Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Documented brief; multi-resource exegesis; systematic internal/external review; managed consistency and governance.

RespondentPersonas.label: Typical Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Workable but informal process; some internal checking and external review; inconsistent tooling.

RespondentPersonas.label: Ad-hoc Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Little documented process; minimal external review; no consistency tooling or outside oversight.

RespondentPersonas.label: Rigorous Mid-Level Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Same profile as tr-strong for a team where mid-level roles (not mother-tongue translators) answer.

RespondentPersonas.label: Typical Mid-Level Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Same profile as tr-typical for a mid-level-role respondent.

RespondentPersonas.label: Ad-hoc Mid-Level Team
RespondentPersonas.description: Same profile as tr-weak for a mid-level-role respondent.

RespondentPersonas.label: Delighted Written-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the translation clear, natural, appealing, in frequent use, and trusted.

RespondentPersonas.label: Mixed Written-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Mostly understandable and appealing, used sometimes, moderate trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Unconvinced Written-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the translation hard to follow or unnatural, rarely used, low trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Delighted Audio-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the recording clear, appealing, in frequent use, and trusted.

RespondentPersonas.label: Mixed Audio-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Mostly understandable and appealing, used sometimes, moderate trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Unconvinced Audio-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the recording hard to follow or unappealing, rarely used, low trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Delighted Video/Sign-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the signing clear, appealing, in frequent use, and trusted.

RespondentPersonas.label: Mixed Video/Sign-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Mostly understandable and appealing, used sometimes, moderate trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Unconvinced Video/Sign-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Finds the signing hard to follow or unappealing, rarely used, low trust.

RespondentPersonas.label: Confident Consultant
RespondentPersonas.description: Highly confident in process, source understanding, consistency, and readiness.

RespondentPersonas.label: Cautious Consultant
RespondentPersonas.description: Moderately confident; wants some adjustments before wide release.

RespondentPersonas.label: Skeptical Consultant
RespondentPersonas.description: Low confidence in process and readiness; significant work still seen as needed.

RespondentPersonas.label: Enthusiastic Involved Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Broad denominational involvement, confident in the team, affirms clarity and readiness.

RespondentPersonas.label: Cautious Involved Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Moderate denominational involvement and confidence; qualified affirmation.

RespondentPersonas.label: Disengaged Involved Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Little denominational involvement or confidence; does not yet affirm readiness.

RespondentPersonas.label: Enthusiastic Community Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Broad involvement, confident, affirms readiness, and observes strong congregational impact.

RespondentPersonas.label: Cautious Community Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Moderate involvement/confidence; observes some congregational impact.

RespondentPersonas.label: Disengaged Community Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: Little involvement or confidence; observes little congregational impact.

RespondentPersonas.label: Enthusiastic Denominational Leader
RespondentPersonas.description: Broad denominational involvement, confident in the team, affirms clarity and readiness.

RespondentPersonas.label: Cautious Denominational Leader
RespondentPersonas.description: Moderate denominational involvement and confidence; qualified affirmation.

RespondentPersonas.label: Disengaged Denominational Leader
RespondentPersonas.description: Little denominational involvement or confidence; does not yet affirm readiness.

RespondentPersonas.label: Overconfident New Team
RespondentPersonas.description: New team with little process maturity yet, but rates its own practice as if it's already solid — hasn't yet learned what rigorous practice looks like. A small, unified team, so its own members largely agree with each other even though that shared self-view runs ahead of reality.

RespondentPersonas.label: Divided Written-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Unclear shared expectations for the translation — responses range from enthusiastic to preferring the language of wider communication instead.

RespondentPersonas.label: Divided Involved Pastors
RespondentPersonas.description: Church leaders hold unclear, differing expectations for the translation — some affirm it readily, others withhold judgment or would rather continue in the language of wider communication.

RespondentPersonas.label: Modest Early Team
RespondentPersonas.description: A promising but unspectacular early-stage team — real process, nothing exceptional yet. Shared starting point for the Trust-vs-Trustworthy scenario pair.

RespondentPersonas.label: Warming Written-Medium Community
RespondentPersonas.description: Modest early warmth, genuinely growing. Shared starting point for the Trust-vs-Trustworthy scenario pair.

RespondentPersonas.label: Modest Involved Pastor
RespondentPersonas.description: A lay pastor cautiously positive early on. Shared starting point for the Trust-vs-Trustworthy scenario pair.

RespondentPersonas.label: Engaged Consultant
RespondentPersonas.description: A trained consultant, highly confident at the outset — a real, functioning review relationship. Shared starting point for the Trust-vs-Trustworthy scenario pair. Low response_spread on purpose: a single trained reviewer answering a structured assessment carefully is a much less noisy source than a population of lay respondents. Baseline is deliberately near the top of CHCC's 3-point confidence scale (Highly/Moderately/Not very confident, scored 100/50/0) so a real decline has room to cross both thresholds rather than hovering inside one bucket the whole time.

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Steadily Improving
TrajectoryPersonas.description: Starts weak everywhere and climbs a little every cycle — no shocks, just gradual capacity building.

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Stymied Plateau
TrajectoryPersonas.description: Starts moderate and barely moves — a project that keeps assessing but isn't actually changing.

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Loses a Translator
TrajectoryPersonas.description: A strong-starting team loses its lead translator mid-project (cycle 3), then partially recovers after training a replacement (cycle 5).

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Earning Trust
TrajectoryPersonas.description: A new translation team over-reports its own competency early on, then corrects sharply as consultant feedback shows how much it still has to learn — while genuinely improving to a moderate-high level by the end. Church and community start with unclear, divided expectations (some call it excellent, others would rather use the language of wider communication) and converge toward broad appreciation as the translation, and the team's self-awareness, matures.

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Trusted, Unchecked
TrajectoryPersonas.description: Starts identically to trust-outvoted-expert: a modest, promising early CBBT project with a real, functioning consultant relationship. From cycle 2 on, community and lay-church warmth grow naturally with the project's overall momentum, but the consultant's confidence and the team's own External Review sub-dimension are both held flat — nobody revisits outside verification as everything else moves forward. The tell: one stagnant sub-dimension amid otherwise-broad improvement.

TrajectoryPersonas.label: Trust Outvotes the Expert
TrajectoryPersonas.description: Starts identically to trust-unchecked. From cycle 2 on, the consultant's actual confidence genuinely craters as they see more of the text — but their respondent count stays fixed at one while lay-pastor and community respondent counts multiply each cycle, so their shrinking, more alarmed voice gets progressively diluted in the pooled Church average by an ever-larger chorus of enthusiastic lay respondents. The tell: the official number can look fine while the one qualified reviewer is quietly screaming.
